summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Rahaal Contract v2 Adapter. Created /app/backend/tests/test_rahal_v2_adapter.py (20 pytest cases): v2 field mapping (package_type->type, name->title, start/end_date->departure/return_date, currency, room_pricing[], package_transports[], components[], hotels[], features[], image_url string+array->images[]), flat-pricing derivation from the base (double) room, legacy flat payload backward-compat, share idempotency by rahal_ref, HMAC auth (X-Rahal-Signature / X-Meraaj-Signature / legacy X-Rahal-Api-Key, 401 on bad sig, 400 on malformed JSON with valid sig), package.updated via the same adapter, matching precedence (meraaj_package_id -> rahal_ref, never title), event-id idempotency, and non-office sanitization (individual + anonymous + market list). 20/20 passed. Pre-existing suites test_rahal_inbound_sync.py + test_rahal_webhook_edges.py re-run: 27/27 passed (no regression). Frontend /market/{id} verified with Playwright for a real v2 share: pkg-room-pricing, pkg-transports, pkg-components, hotels, pkg-features, hero image, dates and type all render; OFFICE sees net+commission columns, INDIVIDUAL sees only room_type+customer (no wholesale leak in DOM). All V2-QA test data and TEST_ accounts cleaned up.

minor.issue: The rahal_packages source-of-truth mirror is NOT refreshed on package.updated — only status is mirrored for activate/deactivate/delete. After a v2 update the mirror keeps the stale payload/room_pricing/transports/components while db.packages holds the new data, so the mirror can no longer be used to replay/audit inbound data.

When the event carries only meraaj_package_id (no package_ref), handled=true is returned even if matched_count==0 (the `handled = recognized and (matched_count>0 if ref else True)` branch), so a webhook targeting a non-existent id is silently ACKed as handled.

No Pydantic/type validation of the inbound v2 body: room_pricing/components/transports are stored verbatim. A non-list room_pricing (e.g. a dict or string) reaches _base_room and would raise a 500 instead of a 400. Recommend validating with a Pydantic model and returning 400 on malformed structures.

issues: Raw English enum values are shown untranslated inside an Arabic RTL page: room_type renders as 'double' / 'triple' / 'quad' in the أسعار الغرف table, and the transport type renders as 'bus' in both تفاصيل الرحلة (النقل) and النقل والمواصلات. Add an Arabic label map (ثنائية/ثلاثية/رباعية, باص/طيران).
مدينة الانطلاق shows '-' because the Rahaal v2 contract has no departure_city mapping — consider mapping departure_city/from_city from the v2 payload or hiding the row when empty.

The route is auth-protected and redirects anonymous visitors to /login even though GET /api/packages/{id} supports anonymous (sanitized) access. Informational: if public/SEO program pages are intended, the route must be public; sanitization on the API side is already correct.

action_items: Mirror the adapted v2 fields into db.rahal_packages on event=package.updated (same $set block as /share) so the Rahal mirror stays authoritative.
Return handled=false / matched_count=0 when a webhook matched by meraaj_package_id finds no package, instead of ACKing handled=true.
Validate the inbound v2 body with a Pydantic model (room_pricing/components/transports must be lists) and return 400 instead of risking a 500.
Arabic i18n for room_type and transport type values on PackageDetail.js; map/hide departure_city for Rahaal v2 packages.
critical_code_review_comments: integration.py is now ~440 lines and mixes outbound outbox, simulated receiver, adapter, share, webhooks and SSO — consider splitting the adapter into rahal_adapter.py for testability.

_adapt_package always overwrites description/departure_city/transport with empty strings on package.updated when those keys are absent from the v2 delta — a partial update (e.g. only meraaj_package_id + name) wipes previously stored description/departure_city. Confirmed in test_update_by_meraaj_package_id: the delta had no description, and the stored description was blanked. Recommend building the $set from only the keys present in the payload.
share_package auto-provisions a seller office with password_hash=None; ensure the login path can never authenticate such accounts (verify bcrypt.checkpw is never called with None).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of v2 detail-page sections rendered correctly

Cleanup helper: /app/backend/tests/cleanup_v2_qa.py removes any leftover V2-QA/RHL-V2/qa-v2.com data. Confirmed-good areas: v2 mapping, flat-price derivation, legacy compat, HMAC auth matrix, idempotency, matching precedence, non-office sanitization, PackageDetail rendering. Open items are the 3 minor backend gaps + Arabic i18n listed above.
rca_of_the_issue: The original audit bug (dropped fields) is fixed: _adapt_package now normalizes both Contract v2 and legacy flat payloads into canonical Meraaj fields and share/webhook both route through it, so room_pricing/transports/components/hotels/features/images/dates/type persist and render. Remaining minor gaps are (a) the rahal_packages mirror is only status-synced on package.updated, (b) handled=true is returned for an unmatched meraaj_package_id, and (c) $set applies adapter defaults for keys absent from a partial update, blanking description/departure_city/transport.
